stories.title: Marco Rubio shares how faith informs his work as 2028 presidential bid rumors mount
stories.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio addressed how his faith played a role in his past work as an attorney and how he believes Christianity is embedded in U.S. systems.

stories.title: Democrats clinch a historic House majority of at least 258 seats, the largest since 1992
stories.summary: House Democrats have secured their best general election in decades, winning 258 seats. It's an election sweep unseen since 1992.

stories.title: Davis County high school artists share stories through their work in art exhibit
stories.summary: Davis County high school artists had the chance to share their artwork in an annual Student Art Competition & Exhibit held on Thursday.

stories.title: Elder Rasband visits Mia Love's son on his mission
stories.summary: Elder Ronald A. Rasband, an apostle of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints, paid a visit to Elder Peyton Love, son of former Utah Rep. Mia Love, to discuss the impact missionary work had on their families and across generations.

stories.summary: The end is in sight, and winning becomes even tougher the later the season goes.

stories.title: A resurgent 'Hunger Games' goes big at the box office, despite competition of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'
stories.summary: Fourteen years and six movies in, "The Hunger Games" movie franchise rediscovered its box-office might, as "Sunrise on the Reaping" debuted with $120 million in North American theaters over the weekend, according to studio estimates Sunday.

stories.title: Why this lawmaker wants to improve glass recycling in Utah
stories.summary: A Utah legislator is seeking to increase glass recycling options in the state, following a $4 million predicament the state found itself in a few years ago.

stories.title: Issue with automation system causes Delta flight delays in Atlanta
stories.summary: An issue with Delta Air Lines' weight and balance automation system was causing flight delays Sunday at its hub in Atlanta and nationwide.

stories.title: Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade balloon handlers will honor Fiona the hippo
stories.summary: Balloon handlers will pay tribute to Fiona the hippo at this year's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade.

stories.title: Japanese Church of Christ celebrates historic roots in Salt Lake City
stories.summary: The Japanese Church of Christ is one of the last anchors of Japantown in Salt Lake City. The historic church recently found a previously unknown time capsule within its walls that details the history of the building and congregation.

stories.title: Josh Furlong's AP Top 25: Utah sits alone at the top as the last remaining undefeated team
stories.summary: It's lonely at the top, but Utah football doesn't mind.

stories.title: Paolo Bulgari, jeweler to Princess Diana and Hollywood stars, dies at 89
stories.summary: Italian jeweler Paolo Bulgari, who helped transform his family business into a global luxury house synonymous with Hollywood glamor, has died in Rome at age 89.
